title: Strategic science communication
short: How scientists’ choices on social media shape trust and engagement.
text: How can scientists use social media effectively? I test how common practices, such as sharing personal details, using humor, or presenting themselves in different ways, shape how audiences perceive and engage with scientists. The goal is evidence-based practice that makes science more approachable and transparent.

title: Inclusive participation in science communication
short: Whose voices are heard in online conversations about science.
text: How do diverse voices shape conversations about science online? I study the experiences of scientists from underrepresented groups, such as Black scientists sharing their work through #BlackInSTEM, and how that visibility changes public ideas of who can be a scientist.

title: Navigating new media technologies
short: How new platforms change the reach of science, health, and environmental information.
text: New media technologies are changing how scientific information is shared and consumed. I study how digital platforms and online communities can improve the reach and reception of science, health, and environmental information and build trust, while limiting risks such as misinformation.
